disclosures: Basic net loss per share is computed by dividing the net loss by the weighted-average number of shares of common stock outstanding during the period. Diluted net loss per share is computed by dividing the net loss by the weighted-average number of shares of common stock and common stock equivalent shares from dilutive stock options and common stock warrants outstanding during the period. Because the Company has reported a net loss for all periods presented, diluted net loss per share is the same as basic net loss per share for those periods as all potentially dilutive securities were antidilutive in those periods.

decisions.reader_note: For Viridian Therapeutics, this review covers only the selected 2021–2023 observations in its 2023 annual filing. The filing excludes potential common shares as anti-dilutive in all those loss periods, so basic and diluted loss per share are equal. Full scale-zero share counts follow the statement’s share/per-share exception to the thousands heading. EPS uses net loss rather than comprehensive loss after investment-value changes. This historical review does not establish the accounting treatment of later filings.
